_about: The Demon Cyborg's energy kit, Combat and Choreography, 2026-10-23. Page: cyborg.md. Only what E81 and the kit sheet (section 14) leave to a fighter, plus the frame's numbers where he sits inside a band; the grammar, ki, hit-stop and rules are the frame's (E10, E100, E102). Fitted to Legal's screen (docs/legal/energy-overhaul-screen.md e11-e14, fx08). Units: 1 bh = 75 units, 60 ticks a second. His whole energy set runs on wreckage and metal, never on people (Legal ln02, ln04). Nothing here is built.
hand: the slatted furnace grille across his chest plate (lob, heavy, beam, blast mine) and the rivet line on his wrist plates (bolts, spark mines). Never a hand-frame, never an arm cannon, never a belly, mouth or head

light.shape: hot rivets popped out of the rivet line on his wrist plate
light._bands: speed 54 a tick (within 20% of 60); damage 14.3 (within 15% of 13): heavier and slower than most. The stream's pace is the frame's (E23)
light.flash: the rivet line holds one steady glow while the stream runs, never a flash per rivet; hits build one steady scorch glow where they land (fx08)
light.look: Tap: a backhand snap of the forearm and one rivet pops out and seeks. Held: the forearm level across his chest, rivets popping down the line one after another. Misses leave rivets smoking in walls and pocks in the ground

medium.shape: a jagged clot of glowing slag thrown out of the chest grille

l2.what: lands short of him (or at the lead) and rolls along the ground toward the point under him as molten slag, burning a glassy track; bursts once when it touches a fighter, reaches the point under him or runs out
l2.water: it sinks hissing and goes off as a steam column (E115's column and ring wave)
l2.mark: a glassy, smoking track ending in a 2 bh crater with a slag rim
l2._l2: rolls up to 4 bh at 15 a tick (20 ticks); the burst reaches 2 bh around and 3 bh up, so a low flyer is caught. Worth x1.4 sits within 15% of level 1's; ki and trade power are the frame's (E32). Each burst is one flash event (fx08)

medium.look: Tap: a hammer fist cocked high, the grille's slats rattle open, and he hammers his own chest plate; the grille throws the clot up and over on a high, slow arc. Mashed: a hammer blow for each lob. Held: he leans back, off hand braced flat on the plate, the grille a step brighter at each level; the stick's lead reads in his shoulders

heavy.look: The gather: both clawed hands prise the edges of his chest plate apart and the grille steps brighter between them; nothing gathers in or above his hands (e12). Released before level 1, he swings his right forearm round from behind like a wrecker's boom, feet planted, never spinning, and slams it onto the grille; the blow knocks a jagged slab of molten scrap out, which tumbles end over end at the foe and leaves a crater studded with scrap
heavy._gather: the gather's hands stay on the chest plate, above the hip zone (Legal, Addendum 3)

beam.shape: ragged jets from the chest grille's slats that merge side by side into one rough, uneven column, its edges tearing and wobbling on a seeded draw, embers falling away (render only). It never rotates: no spiral, drill or helix (e11)
beam._widthSweep: pulled apart from the Protagonist's reference (width 1.2, 32 degrees a second): narrower and slower, the sweep within 20% of 32
beam.end: where it ends on the ground it sinks a pit with a slag rim at the end of its trench; its last 6 ticks sputter out in three uneven surges, each a step under 10% luminance (fx09)
beam._numbers: lengths 20/36/54 ticks, worth x1.0/1.6/2.4 of a heavy, ki 12/20/32: the frame's (E43), inside the kit sheet's bands (damage within 15%, length within 25%). A pulse adds 4 ticks (E50)

trait._note: a struggle look changes only how a surge and a buckle look, never the push (E96)

wobble._note: look only: the limiter's sputter, steadied in the final form. It lives in the edge and the width, never in brightness (or a step under 10% and under 2 Hz, Legal fx09)

beam.charge: one pair of slats opens per level, each a brightness step at the grille with a click and a rumble tick; loaded, the grille holds a steady light, with no pulse over 1 Hz (e12)
beam.pulseLook: he lets go of the plate with one hand and hammers his chest plate; a swell runs down the column to the front, under a 10% brightness step (fx08). B held: he hammers by himself every 8 ticks
beam.struggleLook: surges come as swells heaving down the column; losing, the beam bulges in lumps and sputters back toward the grille, quivering, never thinning (E96)
beam.look: Firing: rooted, leaning back into the recoil, heels dug in, the torso turning slowly to sweep

grab.what: a crane hook on a cable that pays out from a winch drum inside his forearm plate; the hook is thrown by hand
grab.payoffLook: he takes the line in both hands and heaves his chassis through a third of a turn, feet planted, swinging the foe round and letting go: a launch through the planner, 6 bh along the stick (E66, e13)
grab.held: aim, the long cast (E61): a hold from 14 ticks (E14); the hook is lofted ahead of the foe's flight, up to 4 bh by the stick, to catch him where he is going
grab.binds: arms, torso or body; never throat, face or hair. The caught fighter struggles or braces, never limp. No slow motion, zoom or taunt over him, and no finisher starts on a bound fighter (e13)
answers: It beats a guard, as every grab does (E62)
A dodge tap in its last 8 ticks of flight slips it
A shot of trade power 2 or more that meets it in flight knocks it down
A blow that lands on him in his 10-tick wind-up stops it
Caught: each press takes 4 ticks off the hold, one counted every 6 ticks; RT's burst breaks it after its first 12 ticks (E64)
grab.reads: A scrapyard crane working a load: the hook catches round the arms or torso, the line goes taut and the winch ticks. It never reels anyone in
grab._callout: Legal ln06: one call-out per grab, on the throw or in the first 10 ticks of the catch, inside the hit-stop and never extending it; nothing said over the rest of the catch, the payoff or a kneel

trap.what: a wired frame of scrap plates that folds down into a pit; clamps close on a passing fighter's torso, hold him and drop him into the ground. Machinery only: plates and clamps, no teeth, nothing that chews or bites, no swallowing (e14)

numbers.send: down, in place, under the spike's rules
numbers._numbers: worth a level-1 beam (x1.0 of a heavy), inside the kit sheet's 15%. On the ground the field is the column 3 bh above a frame 2 bh across; laid in the air it hangs as a wired knot whose field is 1 bh round it
numbers._frame: lay: 12 ticks of open guard, 12 ki; arms in 30; flares 6 ticks before it closes; one live, a fresh lay fizzles the old; fizzles after 12 s; hit-stop 8, the clamps' hold (E72-E76, E100, E102)

trap.trigger: A foe in its field. The wires light and the plates rattle for 6 ticks (the flare, his window), then the plates fold into a pit, clamps close on his torso for the 8-tick hit-stop, and it drops him into the ground. A send that carries either fighter through it sets it off at once (E74)
trap.answer: Avoid it; set it off with a lob or heavier and the clamps close on nothing; guard takes it at the guard's rate with no drop; a dodge tap in the flare; send the Cyborg through it (E78). It never moves
trap.look: He strips a fistful of wire from his forearm wrap and drops it with a clutch of scrap plate; laid on rubble, it wires the rubble already there. Dim while arming, then a slow glow along the wires. Rusted plates before the final form, new metal in it

snare.look: the crane hook laid on a coil of cable; in its flare the coil twitches and the hook jumps, catching round arms or torso. Payoff the bind, or the throw if he presses A (E75)

mines.spark: one hot rivet hanging in the air, arming with one soft tick and never a repeating beep (Legal e15); a mashed string of them flares staggered (fx08)
mines.blast: a crusted clot of slag, glowing at its cracks
mines._all: every mine fizzles after 12 s and never moves toward people (E76, E79)

collateral: Near occupied buildings his beam and his lob's burst widen to 1.3 (E113), and his mines don't hold for people (E79, the villain's rule). Nothing else touches people: no energy move targets, feeds on or uses bystanders, and no death feeds his hunger (Legal ln02, ln04). Deaths go on his account under the collateral budget (E110)
forms: The grammar and every number are the same in every form (E10). The limiter shows in looks and sound only. Before the final form: dull, uneven rivets with a dry rattle; the slats open partway, the beam wobbles 20% and sputters embers, with a governor click at each level; the winch grinds and its cable smokes; the pit's plates are rusted. Final form, online: the rivet line opens into clean rows of fins; a steady white core runs inside the column (8% wobble, no sputter); a silent winch; new metal plates. His hidden weapons show here only as these looks; the weapons themselves are Art's and Game Design's

en.cyborg.light.tap.tell: none: it fires on the press (E14); the forearm snaps out
en.cyborg.light.tap.pose: a backhand snap of the right forearm; a hot rivet pops out of the wrist plate's rivet line

en.cyborg.light.stream.tell: the forearm held level across his chest, one steady glow along the rivet line
en.cyborg.light.stream.pose: rivets pop down the line one after another, 8 in the opening burst and then one every 8 ticks while held
en.cyborg.light.stream._active: the opening burst; then it loops one rivet every 8 ticks while X is held (E23)

en.cyborg.medium.tap.tell: hammer fist cocked high; the chest grille's slats rattle open
en.cyborg.medium.tap.pose: the hammer fist drives into his own chest plate; the grille throws the slag clot up and over

en.cyborg.medium.mash.tell: the fist stays cocked at the shoulder between blows
en.cyborg.medium.mash.pose: alternating hammer fists to the chest plate, one clot from each
en.cyborg.medium.mash._cycle: 12 ticks: one lob a press at most every 12 (E31)

en.cyborg.medium.charge.tell: leans back, the off hand braced flat on the chest plate; the grille a step brighter at 28 and 48 ticks
en.cyborg.medium.charge.pose: hammer fist held high, shoulders turning toward the lead
en.cyborg.medium.charge._windup: a hold from 16 ticks (E14); level 1 at 28, level 2 at 48 (E32); held past 48 it is loaded, a steady light, and never thrown by itself: when his ki can't pay, it steps down a level (E47)

en.cyborg.medium.throw.tell: the braced hand lifts off the plate
en.cyborg.medium.throw.pose: one heavy hammer blow; the charged clot heaves out of the grille, high

en.cyborg.heavy.gather.tell: both clawed hands grip the edges of his chest plate and prise it apart; the grille steps brighter between them
en.cyborg.heavy.gather.pose: elbows wide, chest forward, heels set; nothing in or above the hands
en.cyborg.heavy.gather._shared: the same gather as the beam until level 1 (E40)

en.cyborg.heavy.swing.tell: the right forearm drawn back behind him
en.cyborg.heavy.swing.pose: the forearm swings round like a wrecker's boom and slams onto the grille, feet planted, no turn; a jagged slab of molten scrap tumbles out at the foe

en.cyborg.beam.charge.tell: the gather held: a pair of slats opens at 30, 54 and 84 ticks, each a brightness step at the grille with a click and a rumble tick
en.cyborg.beam.charge.pose: hands prising the plate apart, elbows wide, flying at half speed
en.cyborg.beam.charge._windup: a hold from 20 ticks (E14); levels at 30, 54 and 84 (E42)

en.cyborg.beam.fire.pose: rooted, leaning back into the recoil, heels dug in; the torso turns to sweep; ragged jets merge out of the grille into one column
en.cyborg.beam.fire._active: 20, 36 or 54 ticks by level (E43), plus 4 a pulse (E50)

en.cyborg.beam.pulse.pose: a hammer fist to his chest plate; a swell runs down the column; the hand grips again

en.cyborg.beam.loaded.tell: held at level 3: the grille holds a steady light, the slats rattle (sound only)
en.cyborg.beam.loaded._when: loaded, 4 ki a second. It never fires by itself: when his ki can't pay for the level, it steps down a level (a pair of slats closes, the grille a step dimmer), and below level 1 it holds as the heavy blast. It fires only when he lets go (E47)

en.cyborg.grab.cast.tell: he unclips the crane hook from his forearm and lets it swing once behind him on its cable
en.cyborg.grab.cast.pose: an underarm-to-overhead heave casts the hook; the cable pays out from the winch inside his forearm plate

en.cyborg.grab.longcast.tell: the hook swings lower and heavier behind him, his shoulders turned to the spot ahead of the foe
en.cyborg.grab.longcast.pose: a longer heave lofts the hook ahead along the foe's flight
en.cyborg.grab.longcast._windup: 10, a hold from 14 (E14), then aimed until release (E61, aim)

en.cyborg.grab.inreach.tell: the hook unclipped and held short in his fist
en.cyborg.grab.inreach.pose: he hooks it round the foe's arm by hand, no throw (E68)

en.cyborg.grab.catch.tell: the line taut, the winch ticking
en.cyborg.grab.catch.pose: feet set, leaning back on the line, the cable wound once round his fist; the foe struggles against it
en.cyborg.grab.catch._active: at most 40 (E60), less 4 a counted press (E64)

en.cyborg.grab.throw.tell: he takes the line in both hands and sets his feet
en.cyborg.grab.throw.pose: a heave of the whole chassis through a third of a turn, feet planted, swinging the foe round and letting go into the planner's launch

en.cyborg.trap.lay.tell: the guard arm stays up; the other hand strips a fistful of wire from his forearm wrap
en.cyborg.trap.lay.pose: he drops the wire with a clutch of scrap plate; it sets as a flat frame, or hangs as a knot in the air
en.cyborg.trap.lay._frames: 12 in all, the lay's open guard (E72)

en.cyborg.trap.pit.tell: the flare: the wires light and the plates rattle
en.cyborg.trap.pit.pose: the plates fold down into a pit and clamps close on his torso, then drop him into the ground; no teeth, no swallowing
en.cyborg.trap.pit._object: a world object, not a fighter pose: arms in 30, flares 6, holds for hit-stop 8

en.cyborg.snare.lay.pose: he sets the crane hook down on its coiled cable
en.cyborg.snare.lay._object: arms in 20, flares 6, then catches as the grab (E73-E75)

en.cyborg.mine.spark.tell: thumb set against the wrist plate's rivet line
en.cyborg.mine.spark.pose: the thumb flicks a hot rivet off the plate; it hangs where it is

en.cyborg.mine.blast.tell: a short hammer fist cocked over the chest plate
en.cyborg.mine.blast.pose: a short blow on the plate drops a crusted clot of slag from the grille

legalAsks: The chest grille reads as a slatted furnace grille across a chest plate: never a round emitter, and never a maw, mouth, teeth, jaw, head or belly (e14)
The beam never rotates: no spiral, drill or helix; never from a hand-frame; never an arm cannon (e11)
No ball, sphere or orb in or above a hand; every charge is a brightness step at the grille; a loaded grille is a steady light (e12)
The gather pose (both hands prising the chest plate's edges apart, elbows wide) checked against the two-handed charge cupped at the hip
No barrel on his arm in any form: rivets pop out of a flat plate's rivet line, and the hook's winch sits inside the forearm plate with the hook thrown by hand
Crane Hook binds arms, torso or body only; the caught fighter struggles; it never reels in and is never whirled overhead; the throw is a planner launch (e13)
Wrecker Swing is a boom swing with the feet planted, never a spin; the slab is jagged scrap, not a ball
Scrap Pit is machinery: plates and clamps on the torso, no teeth, no chewing, no biting, no swallowing (e14)
Wreckage and metal only: no energy move involves bystanders (ln02, ln04)
openQuestions: A siphon payoff (the drain first drawn, now dropped): the catch's remaining ticks move the foe's ki to the Cyborg at 0.5 a tick, at most 20. Only if a payoff may ever move ki
Forms in numbers, proposed and not used: level 3 only in the final form; the final form's speed (wind-ups x0.8)
Scrap Pit through a guard: read as the guard's rate with no drop. Confirm
The rolling lob reaches only 3 bh up: fine as a ground tool against a high flyer?
